description: This file contains assembly code for configuring the SRAM clock settings on Realtek RTL838X hardware, including functions to set clock rates, switch CPU clocks, and perform hardware-specific low-level register manipulations.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_start
methods.description: Entry point for SRAM clock initialization, setting up clock configurations and switching CPU clocks.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Configures the DRAM clock rate by manipulating hardware registers, including PLL settings and clock source switching.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_size
methods.description: Returns the size or offset related to SRAM configuration or initialization.
